name: Pine Labs Ltd
tagline: Recently-listed large-cap payments/merchant-fintech platform with fast revenue growth but still-negative trailing ROE - no confirmed named inflection to justify a growth-thesis label at this size.
business_overview: Pine Labs (NSE/BSE: PINELABS) is a merchant commerce and digital-payments infrastructure platform providing point-of-sale, merchant financing/affordability (EMI, BNPL-style products), and payment acceptance solutions to retailers and enterprises, primarily in India with some international presence. It listed on NSE/BSE via IPO (late 2025).
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 17,000+ Cr (as of Jul 2026 data point; may have moved)
fundamentals_narrative: Pine Labs shows genuinely fast revenue growth (~19% CAGR, ahead of industry) and strong historical profit-growth CAGR (~32%), funded off a debt-free balance sheet - but trailing 3-year ROE is negative, which is common for recently-listed fintech/platform companies carrying pre-IPO ESOP/preference-share accounting noise, and is not yet clean evidence of durable per-share profitability. As a recently-listed, sizable (~Rs 17,000+ Cr) fintech, it is treated as large-cap for screening purposes per this batch's instructions.
